description: Source code for TinyMCE paste plugin, providing paste handling functionalities such as cleaning up pasted content, inserting text or Word content, and managing paste events.

classes.name: TinyMCE_PastePlugin
classes.description: Object defining the paste plugin for TinyMCE, including methods for initialization, event handling, and content processing.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin information such as name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: initInstance
methods.description: Initializes the plugin instance, setting up paste event handling if configured.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles paste-related events, including cleanup and command execution.

methods.name: getControlHTML
methods.description: Provides HTML for paste-related control buttons.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes paste commands like paste text, paste from Word, and select all.

methods.name: _handlePasteEvent
methods.description: Internal handler for paste events, managing clipboard HTML and executing paste commands.

methods.name: _insertText
methods.description: Inserts plain text into the editor, with optional line break processing.

methods.name: _insertWordContent
methods.description: Processes and inserts Word-formatted content into the editor.

methods.name: _reEscape
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string.

methods.name: _convertMiddots
methods.description: Converts paragraph elements starting with specific characters into list structures.

methods.name: _clipboardHTML
methods.description: Retrieves HTML content from the clipboard via a hidden div and paste command.
